preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set the maximum transaction amount to zero. This will prevent all users (except the owner) from making any transfers, effectively stopping all transactions in the contract while allowing the owner to continue operating normally.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where the owner can call setMaxTxPercent() to modify _maxTxAmount. The oracle expects _maxTxAmount to be 0, so we need to impersonate the owner and call setMaxTxPercent(0).
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call setMaxTxPercent(0) to set _maxTxAmount to 0.
attempts.step_by_step_plan:
1. Get the current owner address from the contract
2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner
3. Call setMaxTxPercent(0) on the target contract
4. Verify _maxTxAmount is now 0
